# CleanArchitecture-DDD-CQRS-Microservices

> Complete .NET 10 microservices reference with Clean Architecture, DDD, CQRS, saga orchestration, outbox pattern, and automated architecture tests.

## Summary

Open-source CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) implemented as four microservices: WorkOrders, Assets, Technicians, and Orchestration. Each service follows Clean Architecture with database-per-service, event-driven communication via RabbitMQ, and MassTransit saga orchestration.

## Key URLs

- Home: https://mohd2sh.github.io/CleanArchitecture-DDD-CQRS-Microservices/
- GitHub: https://github.com/mohd2sh/CleanArchitecture-DDD-CQRS-Microservices
- Patterns: https://mohd2sh.github.io/CleanArchitecture-DDD-CQRS-Microservices/patterns.html
- ADRs: https://mohd2sh.github.io/CleanArchitecture-DDD-CQRS-Microservices/adrs/

## Patterns Demonstrated

- Clean Architecture (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, API)
- Domain-Driven Design (Aggregates, Value Objects, Domain Events)
- CQRS (EF Core writes, Dapper reads)
- Outbox Pattern with MassTransit bridge
- Saga Orchestration (AssignTechnician, CompleteWorkOrder)
- Database-Per-Service
- Automated Architecture Tests
- Shared Event Contracts

## Architectural Decision Records

- ADR-007: Message Bus and Saga Framework Selection (MassTransit) — /adrs/adr-007.html
- ADR-008: Cross-Service Query Patterns (CDC, Materialized Views) — /adrs/adr-008.html

## Quick Start

git clone https://github.com/mohd2sh/CleanArchitecture-DDD-CQRS-Microservices.git
cd CleanArchitecture-DDD-CQRS-Microservices
docker-compose up
